page.title: Cargo Teleportation
page.t: Research projects that let your own ships and stations in the same zone hand over cargo instantly, without docking or drones.
Moves into the trade partner's zone and range so the cargo can be teleported without docking.
Moves into teleportation range of the supply ship, waits for the build and receives missiles, drones and deployables by cargo teleportation.
Applies teleportation to freight between ships. Two of your ships exchange cargo without docking, parking or drones when they are in the same zone and no more than 5 km apart.
Extends ship-to-ship cargo teleportation to partners up to 15 km apart in the same zone.
Extends ship-to-ship cargo teleportation to partners up to 30 km apart in the same zone.
Your ships trade with your own stations without docking or drones: the cargo is teleported as soon as the ship is in the station's zone.

Your ships restock missiles, drones and deployables from your own supply ships without docking or parking: the supply ship builds them from its cargo and teleports them over once both ships are within radar range of each other.
Use cargo teleportation for trades between your own ships and stations
